title: How to switch to landscape orientation in Pages on Mac: a complete guide
metaTitle: How to switch to landscape orientation in Pages on Mac
description: Learn how to switch to landscape orientation in Pages on Mac. Follow these simple steps to adjust your document layout for all pages in your file.
targetKeyword: how to switch to landscape orientation in pages on mac
intro: To change your page orientation in Pages, open the Document sidebar on the right side of your screen. Click the Document tab and select the landscape icon under the Page Orientation section to rotate your entire document.
tldr: Click the Document button in the top right corner.
Select the Document tab in the sidebar.
Click the horizontal rectangle icon under Page Orientation.

stats.label: Pages applies orientation to the entire document
Days since the latest version 15.4 release

blocks.text: Apple Pages treats orientation as a document wide setting. This means you cannot have one page in portrait and the next in landscape within the same file. Every page follows the same rule. If you need a mix of orientations, you must manage them in separate files or export them as PDFs to combine later.
Step by step guide to change orientation
Follow these steps to update your document settings. Ensure you are using the latest version of Pages for the best experience.

items: Open the file you wish to modify.
Look at the top right toolbar.
Find the Document icon. It looks like a page.
Click it to reveal the sidebar.
Ensure the Document tab is highlighted.

blocks.text: Many users ask if they can flip just one page. Currently, Pages does not support this. The software architecture applies these layout settings to the master document template. If you have a large table that needs more width, you might need to rotate the table object itself instead of the entire page.

Sometimes your document is landscape on screen but prints in portrait. This usually happens in the print dialog box. Press Command plus P to open the print menu. Check the orientation settings within that specific window before you click print.

If you absolutely must have mixed layouts, create two separate files. Export both as PDFs. Use the Preview app to merge them into a single final document. This is the most reliable way to handle complex layouts in Pages.

When you switch to landscape, your margins might need adjustment. Check the Document sidebar again to tweak your margins. Smaller margins often help when working in landscape mode to maximize your available workspace.
Keep an eye on your rulers. Press Command plus R to show them if they are hidden. They help you align elements when your page is wider.

faq.question: Can I have landscape and portrait in the same document?
faq.answer: No, Pages applies orientation settings to the entire document. You must create separate files if you need different orientations.

faq.question: Is there a keyboard shortcut for orientation?
faq.answer: No, there is no default keyboard shortcut for switching orientation in Pages.

faq.question: Why does my document print in the wrong orientation?
faq.answer: Check your system print dialog (Command + P). Ensure the printer settings match the document orientation.

steps.name: Open Document Sidebar
steps.text: Click the Document button in the top right corner of the Pages toolbar.

steps.name: Select Orientation
steps.text: Click the Document tab and select the landscape icon under Page Orientation.

troubleshooting.problem: Document prints in portrait despite landscape setting
troubleshooting.fix: Check the printer dialog settings via Command + P before printing.
